clips.title: The story
paras: Along the Merchant Coast, Baron Longshore's Head proves the pirate captain's death. Gazlowe posted a public bounty for Longshore's identifiable remains to protect Ratchet's commercial shipping.

Baron Longshore led Southsea Freebooter raids from camps along the Merchant Coast south of Ratchet. His flagship, the Heedless, threatened goblin trade lanes between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. Gazlowe, Ratchet's Chief Engineer, offered a bounty for identifiable proof of Longshore's death. The port authority pays a monetary reward when the pirate's head is delivered.
